title: Trees
source: CMap's `tree_definition` key names the file. CTree::LoadKey (0xB1F60) names one key, `texture` (FINDINGS-definitions.md); that CTree is what reads this file is inferred from the name and the key. `tree_density` is a key of CTerrainGraphical, not of CTree.

file.desc: the trees drawn on the map, by name
